expectations.buyer: SaaS engineering, integration-platform, and enterprise application teams operating many third-party APIs and webhooks
expectations.pain: Provider schema, authentication, endpoint, and webhook changes break integrations and consume maintenance effort
expectations.strongestIncumbent: API gateways, iPaaS, SDK generators, contract testing, observability, provider changelogs, and managed connectors
expectations.biggestRisk: Incumbents already detect or regenerate common changes, while autonomous repair without provider intent can silently corrupt transactions
